panels.figure_caption: High-power view (hematoxylin & eosin, original magnification x200) reveals partial necrosis with intermixed neutrophils of the upper epidermis. Subjacent re-epithelialization is present, with squamatization and vacuolopathy of the basal epidermis.
in_text_mentions: A physical exam showed erythematous patches with bulla and tense vesicles bilaterally on the dorsum of the hands and bilateral lower legs. Punch biopsy was performed for histopathological study. Histologic sections show hyperkeratosis, pallor of the upper epidermis, interface changes, and a superficial and mid-perivascular inflammatory infiltrate (Figure 2). Higher-power examination showed partial necrosis of the upper epidermis and squamatization and vacuolopathy of the basal epidermis (Figure 3).

in_text_mentions: A physical exam showed erythematous patches with bulla and tense vesicles bilaterally on the dorsum of the hands and bilateral lower legs. Punch biopsy was performed for histopathological study. Histologic sections show hyperkeratosis, pallor of the upper epidermis, interface changes, and a superficial and mid-perivascular inflammatory infiltrate (Figure 2). Higher-power examination showed partial necrosis of the upper epidermis and squamatization and vacuolopathy of the basal epidermis (Figure 3).
